name: Kasuga Himawari
source:
"Punibain Loli"

The fierce bull boasting the largest breasts among the sisters, yet mistaken for a junior due to her petite size.

She seems self-conscious about her childish appearance and oversized breasts. When dissatisfied, she puffs out her cheeks with a huff.
